items.context: A letter to the editor of a newspaper

items.prompt: Your front-page headline was a ___ attempt to boost sales, suggesting that the candidate had lied when she had merely made an error.

explanation.en: Sensationalist describes media that exaggerate to attract attention. Sensible means practical and sensitive means easily upset or aware of feelings.

items.prompt: Not only ___ the facts, but you also failed to give her a chance to reply.

explanation.en: After not only at the start of a sentence, the auxiliary comes before the subject: did you distort.

items.prompt: A free press has a duty to hold politicians to ___ without resorting to personal attacks.

explanation.en: The collocation is hold someone to account, meaning to make them explain their actions.

items.prompt: Had the paper checked its sources, it ___ been forced to print a correction.

explanation.en: This is an inverted third conditional (had + subject replaces if), so the main clause needs would have + past participle.

items.prompt: I trust that you will publish a retraction ___ the earliest opportunity.

explanation.en: The fixed phrase is at the earliest opportunity.
